about: Blood on the Clocktower characters. ability and the night reminders are the official text (The Pandemonium Institute); summary and tags are this repo's own. See docs/botc/data/README.md. Night order values are positions in night-order.json.

characters.name: Chef
characters.ability: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.
characters.summary: Night 1: learns how many adjacent pairs of evil players sit around the circle (a run of three evil counts as two pairs).
characters.first_night_reminder: Give a finger signal.

characters.name: Empath
characters.ability: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.
characters.summary: Each night: learns how many of their two nearest living neighbours are evil (0, 1 or 2).
characters.first_night_reminder: Give a finger signal.
characters.other_night_reminder: Give a finger signal.

characters.name: Fortune Teller
characters.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.
characters.summary: Each night: picks two players and learns whether either is the Demon. One good player (the red herring) reads as a Demon to them all game.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Fortune Teller chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).
characters.other_night_reminder: The Fortune Teller chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).

characters.name: Investigator
characters.ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.
characters.summary: Night 1: shown a Minion character and two players, one of whom has it.
characters.first_night_reminder: Show the Minion character token. Point to both the *MINION* and *WRONG* players.

characters.name: Librarian
characters.ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)
characters.summary: Night 1: shown an Outsider character and two players, one of whom has it; or told no Outsiders are in play.
characters.first_night_reminder: Show the Outsider character token. Point to both the *OUTSIDER* and *WRONG* players.

characters.name: Mayor
characters.ability: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.
characters.summary: If three players are alive and the day ends with no execution, good wins. If the Mayor would die at night, the Storyteller may kill someone else instead.

characters.name: Monk
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.
characters.summary: Each night except the first: picks another player, who cannot be killed by the Demon that night.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Monk chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Ravenkeeper
characters.ability: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.
characters.summary: If killed at night, wakes and picks a player to learn their character.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Ravenkeeper died tonight, the Ravenkeeper chooses a player. Show that player's character token.

characters.name: Slayer
characters.ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.
characters.summary: Once per game, in public during the day, names a player; if that player is the Demon, they die.

characters.name: Soldier
characters.ability: You are safe from the Demon.
characters.summary: Cannot be killed by the Demon.

characters.name: Undertaker
characters.ability: Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.
characters.summary: Each night except the first: learns the character of the player executed that day, if any.
characters.other_night_reminder: If a player was executed today, show their character token.

characters.name: Virgin
characters.ability: The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.
characters.summary: The first time they are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, the nominator is executed on the spot (and the day's execution is used up).

characters.name: Washerwoman
characters.ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.
characters.summary: Night 1: shown a Townsfolk character and two players; one of the two has that character.
characters.first_night_reminder: Show the Townsfolk character token. Point to both the *TOWNSFOLK* and *WRONG* players.

characters.name: Chambermaid
characters.ability: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.
characters.summary: Each night picks two other living players and learns how many of them woke that night because of their own ability.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Chambermaid chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Chambermaid chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.

characters.name: Courtier
characters.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.
characters.summary: Once per game at night, names a character; that character is drunk for three nights and three days.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Courtier might choose a character. :reminder: :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Courtier might choose a character. :reminder: :reminder:

characters.name: Exorcist
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then doesn't wake tonight.
characters.summary: Each night except the first picks a player (not the same as last night); if it is the Demon, the Demon learns who the Exorcist is and does not act that night.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Exorcist chooses a player. :reminder: Put the Exorcist to sleep. If the Exorcist chose the Demon: Wake the Demon. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Exorcist tokens. Point to the Exorcist.

characters.name: Fool
characters.ability: The 1st time you die, you don't.
characters.summary: Survives the first time they would die.

characters.name: Gambler
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player & guess their character: if you guess wrong, you die.
characters.summary: Each night except the first guesses a player's character; a wrong guess kills the Gambler.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Gambler chooses a player & a character. :reminder:

characters.name: Gossip
characters.ability: Each day, you may make a public statement. Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.
characters.summary: Each day may make a public claim; if the claim is true, someone dies that night (Storyteller's choice).
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Gossip is due to kill a player, they die. :reminder:

characters.name: Grandmother
characters.ability: You start knowing a good player & their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.
characters.summary: Night 1: learns a good player and their character. If the Demon kills that player, the Grandmother dies too.
characters.first_night_reminder: Point to the grandchild player & show their character token.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the grandchild was killed by the Demon, the Grandmother dies too. :reminder:

characters.name: Innkeeper
characters.ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: they can't die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.
characters.summary: Each night except the first picks two players who cannot die that night; one of them is drunk until dusk.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Innkeeper chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder: :reminder:

characters.name: Minstrel
characters.ability: When a Minion dies by execution, all other players (except Travellers) are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
characters.summary: When a Minion is executed, everyone else (not Travellers) is drunk until dusk the next day.

characters.name: Pacifist
characters.ability: Executed good players might not die.
characters.summary: Good players who are executed may survive (Storyteller's choice).

characters.name: Professor
characters.ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.
characters.summary: Once per game at night (not the first) picks a dead player; if they are a Townsfolk they come back to life.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Professor might choose a dead player. :reminder: :reminder:

characters.name: Sailor
characters.ability: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.
characters.summary: Each night picks a living player; either the Sailor or that player is drunk until dusk. The Sailor cannot die (unless drunk).
characters.first_night_reminder: The Sailor chooses a living player. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Sailor chooses a living player. :reminder:

characters.name: Tea Lady
characters.ability: If both your alive neighbors are good, they can't die.
characters.summary: While both living neighbours are good, those neighbours cannot die.

characters.name: Artist
characters.ability: Once per game, during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.
characters.summary: Once per game, during the day, asks the Storyteller any yes-or-no question privately.

characters.name: Clockmaker
characters.ability: You start knowing how many steps from the Demon to its nearest Minion.
characters.summary: Night 1: learns how many seats separate the Demon from its nearest Minion.
characters.first_night_reminder: Give a finger signal.

characters.name: Dreamer
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself or Travellers): you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.
characters.summary: Each night picks another player (not a Traveller) and is shown one good and one evil character; one is that player's.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Dreamer points to a player. Show 1 good & 1 evil character token, 1 of which is their character.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Dreamer points to a player. Show 1 good & 1 evil character token, 1 of which is their character.

characters.name: Flowergirl
characters.ability: Each night*, you learn if a Demon voted today.
characters.summary: Each night except the first learns whether the Demon voted that day.
characters.other_night_reminder: Either nod or shake your head.

characters.name: Juggler
characters.ability: On your 1st day, publicly guess up to 5 players' characters. That night, you learn how many you got correct.
characters.summary: On their first day, publicly guesses up to five players' characters; that night learns how many guesses were right.
characters.other_night_reminder: Give a finger signal.

characters.name: Mathematician
characters.ability: Each night, you learn how many players’ abilities worked abnormally (since dawn) due to another character's ability.
characters.summary: Each night learns how many players' abilities malfunctioned since dawn because of another character's ability.
characters.first_night_reminder: Give a finger signal.
characters.other_night_reminder: Give a finger signal.

characters.name: Oracle
characters.ability: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.
characters.summary: Each night except the first learns how many dead players are evil.
characters.other_night_reminder: Give a finger signal.

characters.name: Philosopher
characters.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. If this character is in play, they are drunk.
characters.summary: Once per game at night picks a good character and gains its ability; if that character is in play, its owner becomes drunk.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Philosopher might choose a character. If necessary, swap their character token. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Philosopher might choose a character. If necessary, swap their character token. :reminder:

characters.name: Sage
characters.ability: If the Demon kills you, you learn that it is 1 of 2 players.
characters.summary: If the Demon kills the Sage, the Sage learns the Demon is one of two players.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Demon killed the Sage, wake the Sage and point to 2 players, 1 of which is the Demon.

characters.name: Savant
characters.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.
characters.summary: Each day may privately ask the Storyteller for two statements: one true, one false.

characters.name: Seamstress
characters.ability: Once per game, at night, choose 2 players (not yourself): you learn if they are the same alignment.
characters.summary: Once per game at night picks two other players and learns whether they share an alignment.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Seamstress might choose 2 players. Nod or shake your head. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Seamstress might choose 2 players. Nod or shake your head. :reminder:

characters.name: Snake Charmer
characters.ability: Each night, choose an alive player: a chosen Demon swaps characters & alignments with you & is then poisoned.
characters.summary: Each night picks a living player; if it is the Demon, they swap characters and alignments, and the new (former Snake Charmer) Demon is poisoned.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Snake Charmer chooses a player. If they chose the Demon: Show the *YOU ARE* & Demon tokens. Give a thumbs down. Swap the Snake Charmer & Demon tokens. Put the old Snake Charmer to sleep. Wake the old Demon. Show the *YOU ARE* and Snake Charmer tokens & give a thumbs up. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Snake Charmer chooses a player. If they chose the Demon: Show the *YOU ARE* & Demon tokens. Give a thumbs down. Swap the Snake Charmer & Demon tokens. Put the old Snake Charmer to sleep. Wake the old Demon. Show the *YOU ARE* and Snake Charmer tokens & give a thumbs up. :reminder:

characters.name: Town Crier
characters.ability: Each night*, you learn if a Minion nominated today.
characters.summary: Each night except the first learns whether a Minion nominated that day.
characters.other_night_reminder: Either nod or shake your head.

characters.name: Acrobat
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: if they are or become drunk or poisoned tonight, you die.
characters.summary: Each night except the first picks a player; if that player is or becomes drunk or poisoned that night, the Acrobat dies.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Acrobat chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Alchemist
characters.ability: You have a Minion ability. When using this, the Storyteller may prompt you to choose differently.
characters.summary: Has the ability of a Minion character not in play (Storyteller picks it); the Storyteller may ask them to choose again when using it.
characters.first_night_reminder: Show the *YOU ARE* info token and a Minion token.

characters.name: Alsaahir
characters.ability: Each day, if you publicly guess which players are Minion(s) and which are Demon(s), good wins.
characters.summary: Each day may publicly name who the Minions and Demons are; if fully correct, good wins.

characters.name: Amnesiac
characters.ability: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.
characters.summary: Does not know their own ability (the Storyteller invents one). Each day privately guesses it and learns how close they are.
characters.first_night_reminder: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Amnesiac's ability.
characters.other_night_reminder: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Amnesiac's ability.

characters.name: Atheist
characters.ability: The Storyteller can break the game rules, and if executed, good wins, even if you are dead. [No evil characters]
characters.summary: Setup: no evil characters at all. The Storyteller may break rules; if the Atheist is executed (even dead), good wins.

setup_modifier.note: No Minions or Demon are in play; everyone is good.

characters.name: Balloonist
characters.ability: Each night, you learn a player of a different character type than last night. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
characters.summary: Each night learns a player whose character type differs from the previous night's. Setup: may add one Outsider.
characters.first_night_reminder: Point to any player. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: Point to a player with a different character type to the previously shown player. :reminder:

characters.name: Banshee
characters.ability: If the Demon kills you, all players learn this. From now on, you may nominate twice per day and vote twice per nomination.
characters.summary: If the Demon kills the Banshee, everyone learns it, and from then on the Banshee may nominate twice per day and vote twice per nomination.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Banshee was killed by the Demon tonight, announce that the Banshee has died. :reminder:

characters.name: Bounty Hunter
characters.ability: You start knowing 1 evil player. If the player you know dies, you learn another evil player tonight. [1 Townsfolk is evil]
characters.summary: Night 1: learns an evil player; when that player dies, learns another that night. Setup: one Townsfolk is evil.
characters.first_night_reminder: Point to the player marked *KNOW*.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the player marked *KNOW* died today or tonight, point to the new player marked *KNOW*.

setup_modifier.note: One Townsfolk is evil (and knows it).

characters.name: Cannibal
characters.ability: You have the ability of the recently killed executee. If they are evil, you are poisoned until a good player dies by execution.
characters.summary: Has the ability of the most recently executed player; if that player was evil, the Cannibal is poisoned until a good player is executed.

characters.name: Choirboy
characters.ability: If the Demon kills the King, you learn which player is the Demon. [+the King]
characters.summary: If the Demon kills the King, learns which player is the Demon. Setup: adds the King.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Demon killed the King, point to the Demon player.

characters.name: Cult Leader
characters.ability: Each night, you become the alignment of an alive neighbor. If all good players choose to join your cult, your team wins.
characters.summary: Each night takes the alignment of a living neighbour. If every good player chooses to join the cult, the Cult Leader's team wins.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Cult Leader might change alignment. If so, show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumb signal.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Cult Leader might change alignment. If so, show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumb signal.

characters.name: Engineer
characters.ability: Once per game, at night, choose which Minions or which Demon is in play.
characters.summary: Once per game at night, chooses which Minion characters or which Demon character are in play (the evil players change accordingly).
characters.first_night_reminder: The Engineer might choose Minions or Demons. Put the Engineer to sleep. Wake the target(s) one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Engineer might choose Minions or Demons. Put the Engineer to sleep. Wake the target(s) one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token. :reminder:

characters.name: Farmer
characters.ability: When you die at night, an alive good player becomes a Farmer.
characters.summary: When the Farmer dies at night, a living good player becomes a Farmer.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Farmer died tonight, wake a living good player. Show the *YOU ARE* info token and a Farmer token.

characters.name: Fisherman
characters.ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller for some advice to help your team win.
characters.summary: Once per game, during the day, visits the Storyteller for advice on how to win.

characters.name: General
characters.ability: Each night, you learn which alignment the Storyteller believes is winning: good, evil, or neither.
characters.summary: Each night learns which team the Storyteller thinks is winning (good, evil or neither).
characters.first_night_reminder: Give a thumb signal.
characters.other_night_reminder: Give a thumb signal.

characters.name: High Priestess
characters.ability: Each night, learn which player the Storyteller believes you should talk to most.
characters.summary: Each night learns which player the Storyteller thinks they should talk to most.
characters.first_night_reminder: Point to a player.
characters.other_night_reminder: Point to a player.

characters.name: Huntsman
characters.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a living player: the Damsel, if chosen, becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk. [+the Damsel]
characters.summary: Once per game at night picks a living player; if it is the Damsel, the Damsel becomes a Townsfolk not in play. Setup: adds the Damsel.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Huntsman might choose a player. :reminder: If they chose the Damsel: Put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Huntsman might choose a player. :reminder: If they chose the Damsel: Put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.

characters.name: King
characters.ability: Each night, if the dead equal or outnumber the living, you learn 1 alive character. The Demon knows you are the King.
characters.summary: Each night, once the dead are at least as many as the living, learns one living character. The Demon knows who the King is.
characters.first_night_reminder: Wake the Demon: Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & King tokens, then point to the King.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the dead equal or outnumber the living, show the character token of a living player.

characters.name: Knight
characters.ability: You start knowing 2 players that are not the Demon.
characters.summary: Night 1: learns two players who are not the Demon.
characters.first_night_reminder: Point to the 2 players marked *KNOW*.

characters.name: Lycanthrope
characters.ability: Each night*, choose an alive player. If good, they die & the Demon doesn’t kill tonight. One good player registers as evil.
characters.summary: Each night except the first picks a living player; if good, they die and the Demon does not kill. One good player reads as evil.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Lycanthrope chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Magician
characters.ability: The Demon thinks you are a Minion. Minions think you are a Demon.
characters.summary: The Demon thinks the Magician is a Minion, and the Minions think the Magician is the Demon.
characters.first_night_reminder: During Minion Info, point to the Magician and the Demon. During Demon Info, point to the Magician and the Minions.

characters.name: Nightwatchman
characters.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they learn you are the Nightwatchman.
characters.summary: Once per game at night picks a player, who learns who the Nightwatchman is.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Nightwatchman might choose a player. Put the Nightwatchman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Nightwatchman tokens, then point to the Nightwatchman. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Nightwatchman might choose a player. Put the Nightwatchman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Nightwatchman tokens, then point to the Nightwatchman. :reminder:

characters.name: Noble
characters.ability: You start knowing 3 players, 1 and only 1 of which is evil.
characters.summary: Night 1: learns three players, exactly one of whom is evil.
characters.first_night_reminder: Point to the 3 players marked *KNOW*.

characters.name: Pixie
characters.ability: You start knowing 1 in-play Townsfolk. If you were mad that you were this character, you gain their ability when they die.
characters.summary: Night 1: learns an in-play Townsfolk. If they stay "mad" about being that character, they gain its ability when its owner dies.
characters.first_night_reminder: Show the Townsfolk character token marked *MAD*.

characters.name: Poppy Grower
characters.ability: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, they learn who each other are that night.
characters.summary: While the Poppy Grower lives, evil players do not learn who each other are; when it dies, they learn that night.
characters.first_night_reminder: Skip Minion Info and Demon Info. Wake the Demon. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 not-in-play good character tokens.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Poppy Grower died today or tonight, wake all Minions. Show the *THIS IS THE DEMON* token. Point to the Demon. Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to the Minions.

characters.name: Preacher
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player: a Minion, if chosen, learns this. All chosen Minions have no ability.
characters.summary: Each night picks a player; a Minion picked learns it and loses its ability for the rest of the game.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Preacher chooses a player. :reminder: If they chose a Minion: Put the Preacher to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Preacher tokens.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Preacher chooses a player. :reminder: If they chose a Minion: Put the Preacher to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Preacher tokens.

characters.name: Princess
characters.ability: On your 1st day, if you nominated & executed a player, the Demon doesn't kill tonight.
characters.summary: If, on their first day, they nominate a player who is then executed, the Demon does not kill that night.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Princess nominated the player who was executed today, wake the Demon as normal, but no one dies to the Demon's ability. :reminder:

characters.name: Shugenja
characters.ability: You start knowing if your closest evil player is clockwise or anti-clockwise. If equidistant, this info is arbitrary.
characters.summary: Night 1: learns whether their nearest evil player is clockwise or anticlockwise (arbitrary if tied).
characters.first_night_reminder: Point clockwise or anticlockwise.

characters.name: Steward
characters.ability: You start knowing 1 good player.
characters.summary: Night 1: learns one good player.
characters.first_night_reminder: Point to the player marked *KNOW*.

characters.name: Village Idiot
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn their alignment. [+0 to +2 Village Idiots. 1 of the extras is drunk]
characters.summary: Each night picks a player and learns their alignment. Setup: up to two extra Village Idiots, one of the extras drunk.
characters.first_night_reminder: If there are multiple Village Idiots, mark one as *DRUNK*. :reminder: Wake the Village Idiots one at a time to choose a player. Give a thumb signal.
characters.other_night_reminder: Wake the Village Idiots one at a time to choose a player. Give a thumb signal.

setup_modifier.note: 0 to 2 extra Village Idiots replace other Townsfolk; if any extras, one of them is drunk.

characters.name: Butler
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.
characters.summary: Each night picks a master (not themselves); the next day they may only vote when their master votes.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Butler chooses a player. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Butler chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Drunk
characters.ability: You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.
characters.summary: Believes they are a Townsfolk (the Storyteller shows them a Townsfolk token) but has no ability; their information is unreliable. Not added to the bag directly.

setup_modifier.note: Not put in the bag; the Storyteller swaps a Townsfolk token for the Drunk and shows that player a Townsfolk.

characters.name: Recluse
characters.ability: You might register as evil & as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.
characters.summary: May register as evil, and as a Minion or Demon, to other abilities, even when dead. Storyteller decides each time.

characters.name: Saint
characters.ability: If you die by execution, your team loses.
characters.summary: If the Saint is executed, good loses.

characters.name: Goon
characters.ability: Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until dusk. You become their alignment.
characters.summary: Each night, the first player whose ability targets the Goon is drunk until dusk, and the Goon switches to that player's alignment.

characters.name: Lunatic
characters.ability: You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.
characters.summary: Believes they are the Demon and is shown fake Minions and bluffs. The real Demon learns who the Lunatic is and whom they "attack" each night.
characters.first_night_reminder: If there are 7 or more players, wake the Lunatic: Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to any players. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 good character tokens. Put the Lunatic to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the *YOU ARE* info token and the Demon token. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* info token and the Lunatic token, then point to the Lunatic.
characters.other_night_reminder: Do whatever needs to be done to simulate the Demon acting. Put the Lunatic to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the Lunatic token & point to them, then their target(s).

characters.name: Moonchild
characters.ability: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player. Tonight, if it was a good player, they die.
characters.summary: When they learn they have died, publicly picks a living player; if that player is good, they die that night.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Moonchild is due to kill a good player, they die. :reminder:

characters.name: Tinker
characters.ability: You might die at any time.
characters.summary: May die at any time, whenever the Storyteller chooses.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Tinker might die. :reminder:

characters.name: Barber
characters.ability: If you died today or tonight, the Demon may choose 2 players (not another Demon) to swap characters.
characters.summary: If the Barber died that day or night, the Demon may swap the characters of two players (not another Demon).
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Barber died today or tonight, show the Demon the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Barber tokens. If the Demon chose 2 players, wake one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.

characters.name: Klutz
characters.ability: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player: if they are evil, your team loses.
characters.summary: When they learn they have died, publicly picks a living player; if that player is evil, good loses.

characters.name: Mutant
characters.ability: If you are “mad” about being an Outsider, you might be executed.
characters.summary: An Outsider who must not be "mad" about being an Outsider; if they are, the Storyteller may execute them.

characters.name: Sweetheart
characters.ability: When you die, 1 player is drunk from now on.
characters.summary: When the Sweetheart dies, one player becomes drunk for the rest of the game.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Sweetheart died, a player became drunk immediately. If you haven't done this yet, do so now. :reminder:

characters.name: Damsel
characters.ability: All Minions know a Damsel is in play. If a Minion publicly guesses you (once), your team loses.
characters.summary: All Minions know a Damsel is in play. If a Minion publicly guesses the Damsel (one guess only), good loses.
characters.first_night_reminder: During Minion Info, show the Minions the Damsel token. If you haven't done this yet, do so now. If the Damsel was chosen by the Huntsman, show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Damsel was chosen by the Huntsman, show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.

characters.name: Golem
characters.ability: You may only nominate once per game. When you do, if the nominee is not the Demon, they die.
characters.summary: May nominate only once per game; when they do, the nominee dies unless it is the Demon.

characters.name: Hatter
characters.ability: If you died today or tonight, the Minion & Demon players may choose new Minion & Demon characters to be.
characters.summary: If the Hatter died that day or night, the Minions and Demon may each pick new Minion or Demon characters.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Hatter died, wake the Minions & Demons. Each may choose a new character. If they do, show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.

characters.name: Heretic
characters.ability: Whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins, even if you are dead.
characters.summary: Inverts the result: the winning team loses and the losing team wins, even if the Heretic is dead.

characters.name: Hermit
characters.ability: You have all Outsider abilities. [-0 or -1 Outsider]
characters.summary: Has every Outsider ability on the script. Setup: may remove one Outsider.

characters.name: Ogre
characters.ability: On your 1st night, choose a player (not yourself): you become their alignment (you don't know which) even if drunk or poisoned.
characters.summary: Night 1 picks another player and silently joins that player's alignment (without knowing which), even if drunk or poisoned.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Ogre chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Plague Doctor
characters.ability: When you die, the Storyteller gains a Minion ability.
characters.summary: When the Plague Doctor dies, the Storyteller gains a Minion ability.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Plague Doctor died, the Storyteller gained a Minion ability. If you haven’t done this yet, do so now. :reminder:

characters.name: Politician
characters.ability: If you were the player most responsible for your team losing, you change alignment & win, even if dead.
characters.summary: If they were the player most responsible for their team losing, they switch alignment and win, even if dead.

characters.name: Puzzlemaster
characters.ability: 1 player is drunk, even if you die. If you guess (once) who it is, learn the Demon player, but guess wrong & get false info.
characters.summary: One player is permanently drunk. If the Puzzlemaster guesses who (one guess), they learn the Demon; a wrong guess gives false information.

characters.name: Snitch
characters.ability: Each Minion gets 3 bluffs.
characters.summary: Each Minion receives three not-in-play bluffs.
characters.first_night_reminder: Wake each Minion. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 not-in-play character tokens.

characters.name: Zealot
characters.ability: If there are 5 or more players alive, you must vote for every nomination.
characters.summary: While five or more players live, must vote for every nomination.

characters.name: Baron
characters.ability: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]
characters.summary: Adds two Outsiders to the setup in place of two Townsfolk.

characters.name: Poisoner
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.
characters.summary: Each night picks a player who is poisoned for that night and the following day.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Poisoner chooses a player. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Poisoner chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Scarlet Woman
characters.ability: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don't count.)
characters.summary: If the Demon dies while five or more players are alive (not counting Travellers), the Scarlet Woman becomes the Demon.
characters.other_night_reminder: If the Scarlet Woman became the Demon today, show them the *YOU ARE* token, then the Demon token.

characters.name: Spy
characters.ability: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
characters.summary: Sees the whole Grimoire each night. May register as good and as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even when dead.
characters.first_night_reminder: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.
characters.other_night_reminder: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.

characters.name: Assassin
characters.ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, even if for some reason they could not.
characters.summary: Once per game at night (not the first) kills a player, ignoring any protection.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Assassin might choose a player. :reminder: :reminder:

characters.name: Devil's Advocate
characters.ability: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night): if executed tomorrow, they don't die.
characters.summary: Each night picks a living player (not the same as last night); if that player is executed the next day, they survive.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Devil's Advocate chooses a living player. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Devil's Advocate chooses a living player. :reminder:

characters.name: Godfather
characters.ability: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die. [-1 or +1 Outsider]
characters.summary: Night 1: learns which Outsiders are in play. On a night after an Outsider died that day, kills a player. Setup: one Outsider more or one fewer.
characters.first_night_reminder: Show the character tokens of all in-play Outsiders.
characters.other_night_reminder: If an Outsider died today, the Godfather chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Mastermind
characters.ability: If the Demon dies by execution (ending the game), play for 1 more day. If a player is then executed, their team loses.
characters.summary: If the Demon is executed and that would end the game, play continues one more day; if someone is executed that day, that player's team loses.

characters.name: Cerenovus
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are “mad” they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.
characters.summary: Each night picks a player and a good character; that player must be "mad" about being that character the next day or may be executed.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character. :reminder: Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character. :reminder: Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.

characters.name: Evil Twin
characters.ability: You & an opposing player know each other. If the good player is executed, evil wins. Good can't win if you both live.
characters.summary: Knows a good "twin" who knows them. If the good twin is executed, evil wins; good cannot win while both twins live.
characters.first_night_reminder: Wake both twins. Allow eye contact. Show the good twin's character token to the Evil Twin & vice versa.

characters.name: Pit-Hag
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player & a character they become (if not in play). If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
characters.summary: Each night except the first turns a player into a character not in play. Creating a Demon makes that night's deaths arbitrary.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Pit-Hag chooses a player & a character. If they chose a character that is not in play: Put the Pit-Hag to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.

characters.name: Witch
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.
characters.summary: Each night curses a player; if that player nominates the next day, they die. Loses the ability when only three players live.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Witch chooses a player. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Witch chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Boffin
characters.ability: The Demon (even if drunk or poisoned) has a not-in-play good character’s ability. You both know which.
characters.summary: The Demon also has the ability of a good character not in play; Boffin and Demon both know which.
characters.first_night_reminder: Wake the Boffin and the Demon. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Boffin tokens, then the not-in-play good character token.

characters.name: Boomdandy
characters.ability: If you are executed, all but 3 players die. After a 10 to 1 countdown, the player with the most players pointing at them, dies.
characters.summary: If executed, everyone but three players dies; then after a countdown the player pointed at by most dies.

characters.name: Fearmonger
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player: if you nominate & execute them, their team loses. All players know if you choose a new player.
characters.summary: Each night picks a player (all players learn when it is a new one); if the Fearmonger nominates and executes that player, the target's team loses.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Fearmonger chooses a player. :reminder: Announce that the Fearmonger has chosen a player.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Fearmonger chooses a player. :reminder: If the target is different to last night, announce that the Fearmonger has chosen a player.

characters.name: Goblin
characters.ability: If you publicly claim to be the Goblin when nominated & are executed that day, your team wins.
characters.summary: If the Goblin publicly claims to be the Goblin when nominated and is executed that day, evil wins.

characters.name: Harpy
characters.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: tomorrow, the 1st player is mad that the 2nd is evil, or one or both might die.
characters.summary: Each night picks two players; the next day the first must be "mad" that the second is evil, or one or both may die.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Harpy chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder: Put the Harpy to sleep. Wake the 1st target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Harpy token, then point to the 2nd target.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Harpy chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder: Put the Harpy to sleep. Wake the 1st target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Harpy token, then point to the 2nd target.

characters.name: Marionette
characters.ability: You think you are a good character, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are. [You neighbor the Demon]
characters.summary: Believes they are a good character but is a Minion; the Demon knows them. Setup: sits next to the Demon. Not added to the bag directly.
characters.first_night_reminder: Wake the Demon. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Marionette tokens. Point to the Marionette.

setup_modifier.note: Not put in the bag; a good token is given to a player sitting next to the Demon, who is really the Marionette.

characters.name: Mezepheles
characters.ability: You start knowing a secret word. The 1st good player to say this word becomes evil that night.
characters.summary: Night 1: learns a secret word. The first good player to say it turns evil that night.
characters.first_night_reminder: Show the secret word.
characters.other_night_reminder: If a good player said the secret word, wake the player. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumbs-down. :reminder: :reminder:

characters.name: Organ Grinder
characters.ability: All players keep their eyes closed when voting and the vote tally is secret. Each night, choose if you are drunk until dusk.
characters.summary: Votes are cast with eyes closed and the tally is secret. Each night chooses whether to be drunk until dusk.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Organ Grinder either nods their head yes to be drunk, or shakes their head no to be sober. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Organ Grinder either nods their head yes to be drunk, or shakes their head no to be sober. :reminder:

characters.name: Psychopath
characters.ability: Each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die. If executed, you only die if you lose roshambo.
characters.summary: Each day before nominations may publicly kill a player. If executed, the Psychopath dies only if they lose a game of rock-paper-scissors.

characters.name: Summoner
characters.ability: You get 3 bluffs. On the 3rd night, choose a player: they become an evil Demon of your choice. [No Demon]
characters.summary: Gets three bluffs. On night 3 picks a player who becomes an evil Demon of the Summoner's choosing. Setup: no Demon at the start.
characters.first_night_reminder: Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 not-in-play good character tokens.
characters.other_night_reminder: Change the Summoner reminder token to the relevant night. :reminder: If it is night 3, the Summoner chooses a player & a Demon character. Put the Summoner to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Demon tokens & give a thumbs-down.

setup_modifier.note: No Demon at the start; the Summoner creates one on night 3.

characters.name: Vizier
characters.ability: All players know you are the Vizier. You cannot die during the day. If good voted, you may choose to execute immediately.
characters.summary: Everyone knows who the Vizier is. Cannot die by day. If any good player voted, the Vizier may execute the nominee at once.
characters.first_night_reminder: Announce which player is the Vizier.

characters.name: Widow
characters.ability: On your 1st night, look at the Grimoire & choose a player: they are poisoned. 1 good player knows a Widow is in play.
characters.summary: Night 1: sees the Grimoire and poisons a player. One good player learns that a Widow is in play.
characters.first_night_reminder: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Widow needs. The Widow chooses a player. :reminder: Put the Widow to sleep. Wake the player marked *KNOW* & show the Widow token. :reminder:

characters.name: Wizard
characters.ability: Once per game, choose to make a wish. If granted, it might have a price & leave a clue as to its nature.
characters.summary: Once per game may make a wish to the Storyteller; if granted it may carry a cost and leave a hint.
characters.first_night_reminder: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Wizard's ability.
characters.other_night_reminder: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Wizard's ability.

characters.name: Wraith
characters.ability: You may choose to open your eyes at night. You wake when other evil players do.
characters.summary: May open their eyes at night and wakes whenever other evil players wake.
characters.first_night_reminder: Wake the Wraith whenever other evil players wake.
characters.other_night_reminder: Wake the Wraith whenever other evil players wake.

characters.name: Xaan
characters.ability: On night X, all Townsfolk are poisoned until dusk. [X Outsiders]
characters.summary: On night X, where X is the number of Outsiders in play, every Townsfolk is poisoned until dusk. Setup: Storyteller may vary the Outsider count.
characters.first_night_reminder: If X is 1, mark the Xaan with the *X* reminder token. :reminder: :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: Change the Xaan reminder token to the relevant night. If it is night X, mark the Xaan with the *X* reminder token. :reminder: :reminder:

setup_modifier.note: The Outsider count may be set to any value X; that number is the night the Xaan acts.

characters.name: Imp
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.
characters.summary: Each night except the first kills a player. If the Imp kills themselves, a living Minion becomes the new Imp (the "starpass").
characters.other_night_reminder: The Imp chooses a player. :reminder: If the Imp chose themselves: Replace 1 alive Minion token with a spare Imp token. Put the old Imp to sleep. Wake the new Imp. Show the *YOU ARE* token, then show the Imp token.

characters.name: Po
characters.ability: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.
characters.summary: Each night except the first may kill one player or skip; after skipping, it kills three players the next time.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Po may choose a player OR chooses 3 players if they chose no-one last night. :reminder: or :reminder: :reminder: :reminder:

characters.name: Pukka
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.
characters.summary: Each night poisons a player; the player it poisoned the previous night dies and recovers from the poison.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Pukka chooses a player. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Pukka chooses a player. :reminder: The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy. :reminder:

characters.name: Shabaloth
characters.ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.
characters.summary: Each night except the first kills two players. A player it killed the previous night may be brought back by the Storyteller.
characters.other_night_reminder: A previously chosen player might be resurrected. :reminder: The Shabaloth chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder:

characters.name: Zombuul
characters.ability: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.
characters.summary: Each night except the first, only if nobody died that day, kills a player. The first time the Zombuul dies, it survives but appears dead.
characters.other_night_reminder: If no one died today, the Zombuul chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Fang Gu
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st Outsider this kills becomes an evil Fang Gu & you die instead. [+1 Outsider]
characters.summary: Each night except the first kills a player. The first time it attacks an Outsider, that Outsider instead becomes an evil Fang Gu and the old one dies. Setup: one extra Outsider.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Fang Gu chooses a player. :reminder: If they chose an Outsider (once only): Replace the Outsider token with the spare Fang Gu token. Put the Fang Gu to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Fang Gu tokens & give a thumbs-down. :reminder:

characters.name: No Dashii
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Your 2 Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned.
characters.summary: Each night except the first kills a player. Its nearest Townsfolk neighbour on each side is poisoned.
characters.other_night_reminder: The No Dashii chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Vigormortis
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor. [-1 Outsider]
characters.summary: Each night except the first kills a player. Minions it kills keep their abilities and poison a Townsfolk neighbour. Setup: one fewer Outsider.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Vigormortis chooses a player. :reminder: If that player is a Minion, poison a neighboring Townsfolk. :reminder: :reminder:

characters.name: Vortox
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk abilities yield false info. Each day, if no-one is executed, evil wins.
characters.summary: Each night except the first kills a player. All Townsfolk information is false. If a day passes with no execution, evil wins.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Vortox chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Al-Hadikhia
characters.ability: Each night*, you may choose 3 players (all players learn who): each silently chooses to live or die, but if all live, all die.
characters.summary: Each night except the first may pick three players (named publicly); each silently chooses to live or die, but if all three choose life, all three die.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Al-Hadikhia chooses 3 players. :reminder: :reminder: :reminder: In order, wake each target. They nod or shake their head. Put them to sleep before waking the next target.

characters.name: Kazali
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [You choose which players are which Minions. -? to +? Outsiders]
characters.summary: Each night except the first kills a player. Setup: the Kazali picks which players become which Minions, and may change the Outsider count.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Kazali chooses which players are which Minions. Wake each target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Minion tokens & give a thumbs-down.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Kazali chooses a player. :reminder:

setup_modifier.note: The Kazali picks which players become which Minions on night 1.

characters.name: Legion
characters.ability: Each night*, a player might die. Executions fail if only evil voted. You register as a Minion too. [Most players are Legion]
characters.summary: Most players are Legion. A player may die each night. Executions fail if only evil players voted. Legion also registers as a Minion.
characters.other_night_reminder: A player might die. :reminder:

setup_modifier.note: Most players are Legion; the rest are good (Minions are usually absent).

characters.name: Leviathan
characters.ability: If more than 1 good player is executed, evil wins. All players know you are in play. After day 5, evil wins.
characters.summary: Everyone knows a Leviathan is in play. If more than one good player is executed, evil wins; after day 5, evil wins.
characters.first_night_reminder: Announce that the Leviathan is in play. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: Change the Leviathan reminder token to the relevant day. :reminder: You may announce that the Leviathan is in play.

characters.name: Lil' Monsta
characters.ability: Each night, Minions choose who babysits Lil' Monsta & "is the Demon". Each night*, a player might die. [+1 Minion]
characters.summary: The Minions each night choose who holds Lil' Monsta and counts as the Demon; a player may die each night. Setup: one extra Minion instead of a Demon player.
characters.first_night_reminder: Wake the Minions. They choose a player. :reminder: Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* & Lil' Monsta tokens.
characters.other_night_reminder: Wake the Minions. They choose a player. :reminder: Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* & Lil' Monsta tokens. A player might die. :reminder:

setup_modifier.note: Lil' Monsta is not a player; an extra Minion takes its place.

characters.name: Lleech
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You start by choosing a player: they are poisoned. You die if & only if they are dead.
characters.summary: Night 1 picks a host who is poisoned. Each night except the first kills a player. The Lleech dies only when its host dies.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Lleech chooses a player. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Lleech chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Lord of Typhon
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [Evil characters are in a line. You are in the middle. +1 Minion. -? to +? Outsiders]
characters.summary: Each night except the first kills a player. Setup: evil sits in a contiguous line with the Lord of Typhon in the middle; one extra Minion; Outsider count may change.
characters.first_night_reminder: Wake the Lord of Typhon's neighbors. Show the *YOU ARE* and Minion tokens & give a thumbs-down.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Lord of Typhon chooses a player. :reminder:

setup_modifier.note: All evil players sit in one contiguous line with the Lord of Typhon in the middle.

characters.name: Ojo
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a character: they die. If they are not in play, the Storyteller chooses who dies.
characters.summary: Each night except the first names a character; that player dies. If the character is not in play, the Storyteller picks who dies.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Ojo chooses a character. :reminder:

characters.name: Riot
characters.ability: On day 3, Minions become Riot & nominees die but nominate an alive player immediately. This must happen.
characters.summary: On day 3, the Minions become Riot; every nominee dies and must immediately nominate a living player. This must happen.
characters.other_night_reminder: Change the Riot reminder token to the relevant day. :reminder: If it is night 3, you may wake the Minions. Show the *YOU ARE* & Riot tokens.

characters.name: Yaggababble
characters.ability: You start knowing a secret phrase. For each time you said it publicly today, a player might die.
characters.summary: Night 1: learns a secret phrase. Each time they say it publicly that day, a player may die.
characters.first_night_reminder: Show the Yaggababble their secret phrase.
characters.other_night_reminder: For each time the Yaggababble said their phrase today, a player might die. :reminder:

characters.name: Beggar
characters.ability: You must use a vote token to vote. If a dead player gives you theirs, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.
characters.summary: Traveller. Can only vote with a vote token another player hands them; if a dead player gives one, the Beggar learns that player's alignment. Immune to drunkenness and poison.

characters.name: Bureaucrat
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.
characters.summary: Traveller. Each night picks another player whose vote counts as three votes the next day.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Bureaucrat chooses a player. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Bureaucrat chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Gunslinger
characters.ability: Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied, you may choose a player that voted: they die.
characters.summary: Traveller. Each day, after the first vote is counted, may shoot a player who voted in it.

characters.name: Scapegoat
characters.ability: If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.
characters.summary: Traveller. If a player on the Scapegoat's team is executed, the Storyteller may execute the Scapegoat instead.

characters.name: Thief
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.
characters.summary: Traveller. Each night picks another player whose vote counts as minus one the next day.
characters.first_night_reminder: The Thief chooses a player. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: The Thief chooses a player. :reminder:

characters.name: Apprentice
characters.ability: On your 1st night, you gain a Townsfolk ability (if good), or a Minion ability (if evil).
characters.summary: Traveller. Night 1: gains a Townsfolk ability if good or a Minion ability if evil, chosen by the Storyteller.
characters.first_night_reminder: Show the *YOU ARE* info token, then a Townsfolk or Minion token. Swap the Apprentice & Townsfolk or Minion tokens. :reminder:

characters.name: Bishop
characters.ability: Only the Storyteller can nominate. At least 1 opposing player must be nominated each day.
characters.summary: Traveller. Only the Storyteller nominates, and must nominate at least one player of the opposite team to the Bishop each day.

characters.name: Judge
characters.ability: Once per game, if another player nominated, you may choose to force the current execution to pass or fail.
characters.summary: Traveller. Once per game, when someone else nominated, may force that vote to pass or fail.

characters.name: Matron
characters.ability: Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.
characters.summary: Traveller. Each day may swap up to three pairs of players' seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk privately.

characters.name: Voudon
characters.ability: Only you & the dead can vote. They don't need a vote token to do so. A 50% majority isn't required.
characters.summary: Traveller. Only the Voudon and dead players vote; the dead need no vote token and no majority is required.

characters.name: Barista
characters.ability: Each night, until dusk, 1) a player becomes sober, healthy & gets true info, or 2) their ability works twice. They learn which.
characters.summary: Traveller. Each night, one player either becomes sober and healthy with true information, or has their ability work twice, until dusk. They learn which.
characters.first_night_reminder: Choose a player. Wake them, show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Barista tokens, then give a finger signal. :reminder:
characters.other_night_reminder: Choose a player. Wake them, show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Barista tokens, then give a finger signal. :reminder:

characters.name: Bone Collector
characters.ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: they regain their ability until dusk.
characters.summary: Traveller. Once per game at night (not the first) picks a dead player who regains their ability until dusk.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Bone Collector might choose a dead player. :reminder: If necessary, wake the chosen player to use their ability.

characters.name: Butcher
characters.ability: Each day, after the 1st execution, you may nominate again.
characters.summary: Traveller. After the day's first execution, may nominate again.

characters.name: Deviant
characters.ability: If you were funny today, you cannot die by exile.
characters.summary: Traveller. If they were funny that day, they cannot die by exile.

characters.name: Harlot
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a living player: if they agree, you learn their character, but you both might die.
characters.summary: Traveller. Each night except the first, asks a living player; if they accept, the Harlot learns their character but both may die.
characters.other_night_reminder: The Harlot chooses a living player. Put the Harlot to sleep. Wake the chosen player, show them the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, then the Harlot token. If that player nods their head, wake the Harlot and show them the chosen player's character token. Both players might die. :reminder: :reminder:

characters.name: Cacklejack
characters.ability: Each day, choose a player: a different player changes character tonight.
characters.summary: Traveller. Each day picks a player; a different player changes character that night.
characters.other_night_reminder: Before dawn, choose a player not marked *NOT ME*. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.

characters.name: Gangster
characters.ability: Once per day, you may choose to kill an alive neighbor, if your other alive neighbor agrees.
characters.summary: Traveller. Once per day may kill a living neighbour if their other living neighbour agrees.

characters.name: Gnome
characters.ability: All players start knowing a player of your alignment. You may choose to kill anyone who nominates them.
characters.summary: Traveller. Everyone learns a player on the Gnome's team; the Gnome may kill anyone who nominates that player.

characters.name: Deus ex Fiasco
characters.ability: At least once per game, the Storyteller will make a mistake, correct it, and publicly admit to it.
characters.summary: At least once a game the Storyteller makes a mistake, corrects it and admits it publicly.

setup_modifier.note: The Storyteller plans at least one deliberate, publicly corrected mistake.

characters.name: Ferryman
characters.ability: On the final day, all dead players regain their vote token.
characters.summary: On the final day every dead player gets their vote token back.

characters.name: Angel
characters.ability: Something bad might happen to whoever is most responsible for the death of a new player.
characters.summary: Whoever is most responsible for the death of a new player may suffer a penalty.
characters.first_night_reminder: Announce which players are protected by the Angel. :reminder:

characters.name: Buddhist
characters.ability: For the first 2 minutes of each day, veteran players may not talk.
characters.summary: For the first two minutes of each day, experienced players may not speak.
characters.first_night_reminder: Announce which players are affected by the Buddhist.

characters.name: Djinn
characters.ability: Use the Djinn's special rule. All players know what it is.
characters.summary: Announces the special rule (jinx) between characters on the script; everyone knows it.

characters.name: Doomsayer
characters.ability: If 4 or more players live, each living player may publicly choose (once per game) that a player of their own alignment dies.
characters.summary: While four or more live, each living player may once publicly have a player of their own team die.

characters.name: Duchess
characters.ability: Each day, 3 players may choose to visit you. At night*, each visitor learns how many visitors are evil, but 1 gets false info.
characters.summary: Each day up to three players visit the Duchess; that night each learns how many visitors are evil, but one gets false information.
characters.other_night_reminder: One at a time: Wake each player marked *VISITOR* or *FALSE INFO*. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Duchess tokens, then give a finger signal.

characters.name: Fibbin
characters.ability: Once per game, 1 good player might get incorrect information.
characters.summary: Once per game one good player may receive wrong information.

characters.name: Fiddler
characters.ability: Once per game, the Demon secretly chooses an opposing player: all players choose which of these 2 players win.
characters.summary: Once per game the Demon names a player of the other team, and everyone votes on which of the two players' teams wins.

characters.name: Hell's Librarian
characters.ability: Something bad might happen to whoever talks when the Storyteller has asked for silence.
characters.summary: Whoever speaks when the Storyteller has asked for silence may suffer a penalty.

characters.name: Revolutionary
characters.ability: 2 neighboring players are known to be the same alignment. Once per game, 1 of them registers falsely.
characters.summary: Two neighbouring players are publicly known to share an alignment; once per game one of them may register falsely.

characters.name: Sentinel
characters.ability: There might be 1 extra or 1 fewer Outsider in play.
characters.summary: The Outsider count may be one higher or lower than normal.

characters.name: Spirit of Ivory
characters.ability: There can't be more than 1 extra evil player.
characters.summary: Caps extra evil players at one (limits alignment-changing chains).

characters.name: Toymaker
characters.ability: The Demon may choose not to attack & must do this at least once per game. Evil players get normal starting info.
characters.summary: The Demon may skip a kill and must do so at least once; evil gets normal starting info. Used for beginner-friendly or small games.
characters.first_night_reminder: Resolve Minion Info and Demon Info, even though there are fewer than 7 players.
characters.other_night_reminder: If a Demon attack could end the game, and the Demon is marked *FINAL NIGHT: NO ATTACK*, do not wake the Demon.

characters.name: Big Wig
characters.ability: Each nominee chooses a player: until voting, only they may speak & they are mad the nominee is good or they might die.
characters.summary: Each nominee picks a speaker; until voting only that speaker talks, and they must be "mad" the nominee is good or may die.

characters.name: Bootlegger
characters.ability: This script has homebrew characters or rules.
characters.summary: Flags that the script uses homebrew characters or house rules, which are listed for everyone.

setup_modifier.note: House rules or homebrew characters are listed for everyone.

characters.name: Gardener
characters.ability: The Storyteller assigns all players' characters.
characters.summary: The Storyteller assigns characters instead of a random draw.

setup_modifier.note: The Storyteller assigns characters instead of a random draw.

characters.name: God of Ug
characters.ability: One Ug hat. When wear Ug hat, must speak one sound at a time but vote twice. If fail, pass Ug hat.
characters.summary: One player wears the "Ug hat": speaks one sound at a time but votes twice; failing passes the hat on.

characters.name: Hindu
characters.ability: The first 4 players to die are immediately reincarnated as Travellers of the same alignment.
characters.summary: The first four players to die return as Travellers of the same alignment.

characters.name: Knaves
characters.ability: There are 2 Storytellers: one lies & one tells the truth. Once per game, at dusk, they might switch.
characters.summary: Two Storytellers run the game: one always lies, one tells the truth, and they may swap once at dusk.

characters.name: Pope
characters.ability: There are duplicate good characters in play. They might also be bluffs.
characters.summary: Duplicate good characters may be in play, and may also be bluffs.

setup_modifier.note: Duplicate good characters may be dealt.

characters.name: Storm Catcher
characters.ability: Name a good character. If in play, they can only die by execution, but evil players learn which player it is.
characters.summary: Names a good character; if in play it can only die by execution, but evil learns who it is.
characters.first_night_reminder: Announce which character is stormcaught. If that character is in play, mark that player as *STORMCAUGHT*. Wake each evil player and show them the character token, then the marked player.  If not in play, wake each evil player, show them the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token & the relevant character token.

characters.name: Tor
characters.ability: Players don't know their character or alignment. They learn them when they die.
characters.summary: Players do not know their character or alignment until they die.
characters.first_night_reminder: Skip Minion Info and Demon Info.
characters.other_night_reminder: If a player died tonight, show the *YOU ARE* info token, their character token, & give a thumb signal.

setup_modifier.note: Players are not told their character or alignment.

characters.name: Ventriloquist
characters.ability: If a player is mad as a fresh character during their nomination, they might not die if executed today.
characters.summary: A nominee who is "mad" about being a new character during their nomination may survive execution that day.

characters.name: Zenomancer
characters.ability: One or more players each have a goal. When achieved, that player learns a piece of true info.
characters.summary: One or more players have secret goals; achieving one earns a piece of true information.
